Dataset brief description: The Cinema Context RDF dataset is a Linked Data representation converted from MySQL data of the Dutch Cinema Context. It uses RDF and Semantic Web vocabularies such as Schema.org, with links to external resources including IMDb and Wikidata, and is distributed in TriG format for SPARQL-based querying.
